faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the MGU Kerala Computer Lab In-Charge recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the MGU Kerala Computer Lab In-Charge recruitment is 05 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Computer Lab In-Charge post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a BCA, BSc Computer Science, BSc IT, a 3-year Diploma in Computer Science, or a Diploma in Computer Application to be eligible for this post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the MGU Kerala Computer Lab In-Charge position?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Computer Lab In-Charge position is between 18 years and 40 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST/OBC candidates as per university rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Computer Lab In-Charge role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Computer Lab In-Charge post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 15,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Computer Lab In-Charge post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Computer Lab In-Charge position in the Mahatma Gandhi University, Kerala.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application for the MGU Kerala Computer Lab In-Charge recruitment must be submitted through the offline mode. Candidates need to send their applications to the official address.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the MGU Kerala Computer Lab In-Charge posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the MGU Kerala Computer Lab In-Charge recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Computer Lab In-Charge position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Computer Lab In-Charge post will primarily involve an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Mahatma Gandhi University, Kerala, which is mgu.ac.in. Direct links are provided in the Important Links section.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment for the Computer Lab In-Charge post is on a contract basis. Selected candidates will be appointed for a specific contract period.
